title: Hisaab stored state (localStorage key hisaab.v1)
description: The open shop, saved by save() in app.js as one JSON document under the localStorage key "hisaab.v1" after every change. A saved value without customers and entries lists is ignored and the app starts an empty shop ("My shop"). No timestamps and no customer ids are stored: a customer is identified by the phone. Language, theme, other shops and WhatsApp check answers are under their own keys; see ../data-model.md.

shop.description: Shop name shown in the header and used in reminder messages and export file names. "My shop" for a blank shop. Set by import or by the settings form (#shop-input, maxlength 60; an empty value keeps the old name).

upi.description: The shop's UPI ID, trimmed, or "" when not set. A value must pass validUpi() (see links.md). When "", every UPI link uses the demo ID hisaab.demo@upi.

nativeDigits.description: Optional. Written only when the tick box for Hindi or Telugu digits is used. Absent means false.

customers.description: Customers in the order they were added or imported. Phones are unique: the add form refuses a duplicate and import keeps the first.

name.description: Name, trimmed (add form #customer-name and edit form #cust-edit-name, maxlength 60; import may give a longer name or the phone number).

phone.description: Ten-digit phone, the customer's key. "Change phone number" on the customer page replaces it and moves the customer's entries to the new number.

name_hi.description: Name in Devanagari. Present after import when given, or after the customer edit form is saved (then it may be "", meaning use the automatic transliteration).

name_te.description: Name in Telugu script, same rules as name_hi.

entries.description: Entries in the order they were added (an undone delete goes back to its old position). Display order is worked out at render time, not stored.

id.description: Made by uid(): "e" + Date.now() in base 36 + up to 5 random base-36 characters; imported entries also get their array index appended. Used by edit, delete and the running balance.

phone.description: The customer this entry belongs to (foreign key to customers[].phone).

type.description: credit adds to what the customer owes; payment takes it off.

amount.description: Whole rupees. A typed entry must be above 0 and at most 10,000,000, and one with paise is not saved. A loaded file may hold up to 1e12; paise in it are rounded, halves up. Amounts stored earlier with paise are shown as stored, with an offer to round them.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. The date box of the entry form does not offer a day after today; a loaded file may hold one.

note.description: Short note, trimmed, may be "". The form field allows 80 characters; import keeps up to 200.

shot.description: Payment screenshot or null. From the form: a JPEG data URL at quality 0.72, longest side at most 600 px, drawn on white. From a file: the data:image/ URL it held, unless it was longer than 400,000 characters. Choosing a screenshot switches the entry to payment.

seq.description: Tie-breaker for entries on the same date. Import sets it to the entry's index in the file; a new entry gets the highest seq plus 1; editing keeps it.

owner.description: Optional. Owner name, from Shop profile (profile.js).

address.description: Optional. Shop address, from Shop profile.

logo.description: Optional. Shop logo as a data URL, shrunk until it is under 40 KB; one from a backup file is accepted up to 60 KB.
